description: This Java class 'JpaBaseEventDao' implements the 'EventDao' interface and manages event data persistence, retrieval, and cleanup in a SQL database for the Thingsboard platform. It handles various event types, batching, partitioning, and filtering logic.

classes.name: JpaBaseEventDao
classes.description: Implementation of EventDao for managing event persistence, retrieval, and cleanup in SQL database.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the queue and repositories after construction.

methods.name: saveAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously saves an event, assigning ID and timestamp if necessary, and enqueues it for batch insertion.

methods.name: findEvents
methods.description: Retrieves events for a tenant and entity within a time range, paginated.

methods.name: findEventByFilter
methods.description: Retrieves events based on complex filters and event type.

methods.name: removeEvents
methods.description: Removes events for a tenant and entity within a time range, optionally filtered by event type.

methods.name: removeEvents
methods.description: Removes events based on filter and time range.

methods.name: findLatestEvents
methods.description: Retrieves the latest events for an entity and event type.

methods.name: findLatestDebugRuleNodeInEvent
methods.description: Finds the latest debug rule node event for a tenant and entity.

methods.name: cleanupEvents
methods.description: Cleans up old events based on expiration timestamps, for regular and debug events.
